categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Shuanglin Auto Parts Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive parts manufacturing, including automotive interior and exterior components, precision parts, intelligent control system components, new energy power systems, wheel hub bearings, planetary roller screws, and ball screws. The company also develops products for humanoid robots and low-altitude economy sectors such as vehicle-mounted drones and aircraft electric drive systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as precision worm gear and screw manufacturing, electric motor and control system design, oil-cooled flat wire technology for hybrid platforms, and high-precision grinding technologies. It has developed proprietary products like electric headrest actuators, automatic steering wheel folding actuators, and reverse planetary roller screws for humanoid robots. Production methods emphasize modular, platform-based manufacturing with high automation and lean production principles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international OEMs and first-tier suppliers such as BYD, Changan, XPeng, Li Auto, Great Wall, SAIC, NIO, and global new energy vehicle brands. The company serves the automotive industry, particularly the new energy vehicle segment, and is expanding into humanoid robotics and low-altitude aerial transportation markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production and R&D bases in Ningbo, Shanghai, Chongqing, Suzhou, Qingdao, Tianjin, and other cities. It has established overseas subsidiaries and manufacturing facilities in Thailand, Singapore, Australia, and the United States, serving markets in Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Shuanglin operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying key automotive components directly to OEMs and first-tier suppliers. It also extends upstream by integrating precision grinding equipment manufacturing through strategic acquisitions, enhancing control over critical production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in automotive electric drive systems, intelligent control components, and humanoid robot core parts such as planetary roller screws and joint modules. It is advancing R&D in AI-driven quality prediction, digitalization of operations, and expanding into the low-altitude economy with products like vehicle-mounted drone clamps and aircraft electric drives. Strategic acquisitions aim to complete the industrial chain and reduce reliance on foreign technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of automotive parts and components to OEMs and first-tier suppliers. The company employs a make-to-order production model with direct sales and project-based contracts. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Shuanglin is a leading domestic player in automotive seat drive systems and wheel hub bearings, holding significant market share with strong partnerships with major OEMs. It competes with other automotive parts manufacturers in China and internationally, leveraging its technological innovation and integrated supply chain to maintain a competitive edge. Its expansion into humanoid robotics and low-altitude economy sectors positions it as an emerging innovator in new markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.91 billion, an 18.64% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 497 million, a 514.49% increase. It maintains a robust asset base of over RMB 6.27 billion and has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by expanding production capacity and new product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Shuanglin emphasizes technological leadership, product reliability, and cost efficiency. Its proprietary technologies in precision transmission components, low-noise and high-precision actuators, and integrated electric drive platforms differentiate it in the automotive and robotics markets. The company’s globalized supply chain, rapid response capabilities, and comprehensive product portfolio enable it to meet diverse customer needs and support the transition to intelligent and new energy vehicles.
